answer: Mint identities only at synchronous admission ceremonies: brief scheduled events where every applicant must interact live and simultaneously, and each attendee leaves with exactly one slot. A farmer cannot be in two places at once, so a whole fleet of puppets gains no more harbor than its single operator earned; what sounds like a fable becomes arithmetic - one body, one ceremony, one identity - and no pigment of forged history can paint a clone into the roll afterward.
